title: The STAT1-SLC31A1 axis: Potential regulation of cuproptosis in diabetic retinopathy.
authors: Hu, Qiang; Zhang, Xue; Huang, Jiayang; Peng, Hongsong; Sun, Yage; Sang, Wei; Jiang, Bo; Sun, Dawei
one_liner_zh: 该文研究糖尿病视网膜病变中铜死亡相关基因及STAT1-SLC31A1轴的表达调控，属于纯转录组与湿实验验证，无蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题仅边缘相关。
abstract: BACKGROUND: By identifying molecular biological markers linked to cuproptosis in diabetic retinopathy (DR), new pathobiological pathways and more accessible diagnostic markers can be developed. METHODS: The datasets related to DR were acquired from the Gene Expression Omnibus database, while genes associated with cuproptosis were sourced from previously published compilations. Consensus clustering was conducted to delineate distinct DR subclasses. Feature genes were identified utilizing weighted correlation network analysis (WGCNA). Additionally, two machine-learning algorithms were employed to refine the selection of feature genes. Finally, we conducted preliminary validation experiments to ascertain the involvement of cuproptosis in DR development and the transcriptional regulation of critical genes using both the streptozotocin-induced diabetic mouse model and the high glucose-induced BV2 model. RESULTS: In the STZ-induced diabetic mouse retinas, a decrease in the expression of cuproptosis signature proteins (FDX1, DLAT, and NDUFS8) suggested the occurrence of cuproptosis in DR. Subsequently, the expression of eight cuproptosis differential genes was validated through the STZ-induced diabetes and oxygen-induced retinopathy (OIR) models, with the key gene SLC31A1 showing upregulation in both models and dataset species. Further analyses, including weighted gene co-expression network analysis, GSVA, and immune infiltration analysis, indicated a close correlation between cuproptosis and microglia function. Additionally, validation in an in vitro model of microglia indicated the occurrence of cuproptosis in microglia under high glucose conditions, alongside abnormal expression of STAT1 with SLC31A1. CONCLUSION: Our findings suggest that STAT1/SLC31A1 may pave the way for a deeper comprehension of the mechanistic basis of DR and offer potential therapeutic avenues.
abstract_zh: 背景：通过识别与糖尿病视网膜病变（DR）中铜死亡（cuproptosis）相关的分子生物学标志物，可以开发新的病理生物学途径和更易获取的诊断标志物。方法：从基因表达综合（Gene Expression Omnibus）数据库获取与DR相关的数据集，而铜死亡相关基因则来源于先前发表的汇编。采用共识聚类来描绘不同的DR亚类。利用加权相关网络分析（WGCNA）识别特征基因。此外，应用两种机器学习算法以优化特征基因的选择。最后，我们进行了初步验证实验，以确定铜死亡在DR发展中的参与以及关键基因的转录调控，使用链脲佐菌素诱导的糖尿病小鼠模型和高糖诱导的BV2模型。结果：在STZ诱导的糖尿病小鼠视网膜中，铜死亡标志蛋白（FDX1、DLAT和NDUFS8）表达下降，提示DR中发生铜死亡。随后，通过STZ诱导的糖尿病和氧诱导视网膜病变（OIR）模型验证了八个铜死亡差异基因的表达，其中关键基因SLC31A1在两种模型和数据集物种中均显示上调。进一步分析，包括加权基因共表达网络分析、GSVA和免疫浸润分析，表明铜死亡与小胶质细胞功能密切相关。此外，在小胶质细胞体外模型中的验证表明，在高糖条件下小胶质细胞发生铜死亡，同时STAT1与SLC31A1表达异常。结论：我们的发现表明，STAT1/SLC31A1可能为更深入理解DR的机制基础铺平道路，并提供潜在的治疗途径。
